title: Chapter 65: Zerg Territory Expansion
content:
Chapter 65: Zerg Territory Expansion

Hearing is false, seeing is true!

Wu Qing transferred two hosts from the Tiger Territory and asked them to take back the talent of reducing their presence, and demonstrated their communication and remote information transmission capabilities to everyone.

Everyone was amazed by the host's ability.

In addition to the stronger mental power and convenient communication with others, the host is actually no different from other Zerg.

Long-distance communication still relies on the Zerg information network, and the host is not an individual, it can only be regarded as a conscious clone of the Queen.

Wu Qing explained the ability of long-distance communication as the ability of the host, which is a deliberate misleading.

The communication network established for the alliance is operated by the Queen behind the scenes, and the information transmitted by the alliance through this network is under the control of the Queen.

Everyone knows this well, and truly private information will not be transmitted through the network established by the Zerg.

This is like a public communication channel within the alliance, which everyone can use, and the information within the alliance is not confidential.

Solving the big problem of communication, other problems are relatively easy to solve. There are many more detailed problems, which will not be discussed today.

In the afternoon, the alliance was settled, and lords kept saying goodbye and leaving. In the end, only Wu Qing and the lords of the four territories who needed to send troops tomorrow were left.

Everyone made some arrangements for tomorrow's troops, and the four territories had to go back to prepare.

A thousand elite troops also need to do a lot of preparation. They are not like Zerg, who need to eat, drink, defecate and urinate. Going out to fight, there are more things to prepare.

The four people said goodbye one by one, and in the end, only Wu Qing remained in the Tiger Territory.

"Wu Qing, don't you need to go back to prepare? After all, there are 15,000 Zerg troops going out. Once they go out, it may take many days to come back!"

Meng asked Wu Qing.

"No need. Most of the Zerg troops have arrived at your territory. The rest will arrive tomorrow morning."

"The Zerg are special. They rely very little on logistics. There is nothing to prepare."

"Tomorrow when we arrive at the Tengu's territory, you can use the fact that the Zerg did not bring supplies. Try to get as many supplies as possible. It doesn't matter if you can't get them. The Zerg can fight without food and water for a short period of time."

Wu Qing said with a smile.

The Zerg can speed up the recovery of energy if they have something to eat. As long as they don't eat their own food, they will eat it.

The Tengu are not enemies, but at least they are no longer friends. They will take advantage of them.

"Haha, don't worry! I won't be polite to the Tengu!"

"Being unreasonable is also my strong point! Hahaha!"

"..."

The two exchanged some of their ideas in private and formed a unified opinion.

The city occupied by the bear goblins was surrounded by puppies sent by Wu Qing.

According to Wu Qing's calculation, there are at least hundreds of thousands of troops in the city, and this place has become a large barracks.

During the day, the teams transporting supplies to the city are endless, which makes Wu Qing excited.

Wu Qing and the Queen of the Insects have deduced many plans to cut off the enemy's food supply and rob the enemy's supplies. In the end, they found that the current strength of the Zerg is still a little weak and cannot support such actions.

If a bad operation stimulates the sensitive nerves of the army in this city, causing them to explode and have to find Wu Qing to fight to the death, then it will be troublesome.

If they find the Zerg base, Wu Qing will be even more embarrassed.

Therefore, unless the bear goblin tribe takes the initiative to send troops out to sweep, otherwise, Wu Qing will not go to trouble them.

Now is not the time to take the initiative to attack, and things that attract hatred for the Tengu tribe cannot be done.

Tomorrow, the main force of the Zerg tribe will set out. Wu Qing and the Queen of the Insects have formulated a detailed response plan for the possible actions of the bear goblin tribe.

If the situation is critical, Wu Qing will lead the troops to kill directly back.

Wu Qing discovered that if it weren't for the strange influence, the distance between the territories was not far. According to Meng's description, the battlefield of the great battle that he was going to tomorrow would not take much time to go back and forth if he rushed at full speed.

...

In the Zerg territory, a large number of worker bees were going in and out under the mountain of the Endless Mountains. After so many days of excavation, they had excavated a space under the mountain that was much larger than the underground space under the new city of Daxia Territory.

Wu Qing discovered that the Endless Mountains were a treasure house with rich mineral resources underground. The worker bees mined day and night, providing basic energy guarantee for the development of the Zerg.

Inspired by the underground base of the new city of Daxia Territory, Wu Qing simply built and expanded the Zerg mother nest and buildings into the underground space of the excavated mountain.

This is much more concealed and safe than expanding outward in the open air, and it is also convenient for the worker bees to mine resources underground.

Wu Qing used the resources obtained from yesterday's battle to build 20 mother nests in the underground space of the mountain and hatched 300 worker bees, who were specifically responsible for the mining of underground resources.

At this time, the number of worker bees has reached 800. Except for a small number of them helping to build the new city, the rest of the worker bees are constantly mining resources.

With the continuous support of these resources, the energy resources of the Zerg can basically meet the development needs of the Zerg when they are not fighting.

It can support the Zerg to continuously produce Zerglings at a certain speed. Now the population limit of the Zerg is no longer a problem. After a period of accumulation, the total number of troops like Zerglings, which consume very few resources, will reach a terrifying level.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The sea of dogs that Wu Qing has been thinking about will soon be truly formed.

80 mother nests, 800 worker bees, 1,000 hosts, 2,000 hydralisks, many Zerglings, and the densely packed defensive buildings on the Zerg territory are the development results of Wu Qing in recent days, and also his confidence.

…

In Daxia Territory, Wu Qing saw that the overall construction progress of the new city was very good.

The structure of the city wall is relatively simple. With the participation of worker bees, the construction speed is very fast. In a few days, the main body of the city wall should be built.

The construction of residential houses requires a lot of manual participation, and the construction speed is relatively slow. Rows of houses built according to Wu Qing's design style are slowly taking shape.

It won't be long before the people of Daxia Territory will have their own houses.

Wu Qing saw through the dog that was scouting outside that some territories that had joined the alliance were transporting support materials and rushing towards Daxia Territory.

The lords of these territories either wanted to contribute to the alliance or wanted to please Wu Qing, and their actions were a bit too quick.

Wu Qing found Hu Tu through the insects. This fox guy was following the beaver tribe leader to learn the overall management of urban construction.

Wu Qing's vision of people was still very good. This Hu Tu was indeed a fox with a family heritage. He was very smart and studious, and he was also very clever.

Hu Tu's learning ability was very strong. With the opportunity provided by Wu Qing, he was soaring and achieved good results in all aspects.

Wu Qing personally talked to Hu Tu through the identity card, told him the news that various territories were about to provide support to Daxia Territory, and taught him how to deal with it.

Wu Qing was not worried about Hu Tu's lack of experience. What he was worried about was Hu Tu's well-maintained innocence and kindness, which needed the queen of insects to remind him at all times.
